desc: In celebration of the 60th Anniversary of the timeless 10/22 rimfire carbine, Sturm, Ruger & Co., Inc. is proud to introduce the Sixth Edition of the Ruger Collector's Series - the 60th Anniversary 10/22 Carbine. This rifle features a stainless steel barrel and silver-finished receiver paired with a Gray Magpul Hunter X-22 stock. The blackened bolt is laser engraved with a unique 60th Anniversary marking. The rifle is accented with a red bolt handle and trigger and utilizes popular 10/22 features like a non-glare blade front sight, ghost ring adjustable rear aperture sight, extended magazine release, and a Picatinny rail. The 60th Anniversary 10/22 ships in a Collector's Series box with a Sixth Edition Ruger Collector's Series metal street sign and pin.
